## Decisions and why
- The budget comes from a real ceiling, not taste: `additionalContext` truncates
  at 8000 characters or 200 lines, silently. A 14200-token handoff arrives cut.
- The handoff is written after compacting, never before: at 70-80% of the window
  the drafting itself can trigger the compaction it meant to pre-empt.
- `PreCompact` was dropped — no model turn, so it cannot draft. `PostCompact`
  carries `compact_summary` and `Stop` has the turn.
- The compaction summary is input, never the product: the real one measured
  12780 bytes against a 6000-character budget. Distil it, do not copy it.
- `memory` is the fallback for every ambiguity. An unreadable document must never
  authorise continuing work.
- Config keys and the mode enum stay English in every language; `language` only
  changes what a human reads.

## Traps
- `.baton/` must be excluded when counting COMMITS too, not just changed files.
  Committing the handoff is what the design tells you to do, so counting it made
  the freshness notice fire on every session — and one that always fires is one
  the model learns to ignore. Fixed in 0.3.1, found by the manual test.
- A parameter named after an imported module shadows it: `wrap(document=...)`
  broke the safe-mode fallback and no unit test caught it.
- Bumping the version is required for `claude plugin update` to pick up changes,
  and a restart is required for hooks to reload.
- Unit tests cannot see the failures that only appear on a real install. The
  manual acceptance checks in the README are not optional ceremony.
